ColonyCouncil.AdvisorSignalDef.label: hay short of the herd's winter

tips.li: Grazing animals eat grass while it grows and hay or kibble once it stops. A herd that grew all summer can eat the stores bare by midwinter.
Haygrass grows fast and keeps for a long time once cut; a field of it sown in summer is the herd's winter.
Fewer animals through the winter, and more of them born in spring, is how most herders get by.
Each animal has the coldest it can bear; below it, it gets hypothermia like anyone else. A roofed barn keeps the wind off even without a heater.
[lowtech] A campfire in the barn, behind a wall, keeps a herd through a hard night.
Animals in a pen can't come in by themselves. A barn door inside the pen lets them.
A fuelled generator only runs while someone keeps it fed. A stack of its fuel in the stores, near it, keeps the haulers ahead of it.
Batteries carry a grid through a generator's gap; without them the lights go out the moment it stops.
Saving the power, a decree, switches the lamps off at night and lets the batteries carry the dark hours.

ColonyCouncil.AdvisorSignalDef.label: plans waiting on stuff the colony lacks

tips.li: A blueprint the stores can't pay for still sends builders and haulers looking. Plans for what can be built now get built sooner.
The same plan in a stuff the colony has (wood for steel, stone for wood) can go up today.

ColonyCouncil.AdvisorSignalDef.label: trees giving cover by the walls

tips.li: A tree is cover for whoever stands behind it. Close to a wall, it's cover for the attackers, not the defenders.
Open ground outside the wall, for a few steps at least, gives the defenders the shots.
Trees also burn. A fire in a wood that touches the wall comes over it.

ColonyCouncil.AdvisorSignalDef.label: deep snow and nowhere to clear

tips.li: Deep snow slows everyone who walks through it. The snow-clearing area tells the cleaners where to shovel.
Paths between the beds, the table, the stores and the workshop are worth more than clearing everything.
An ideoligion's moral guide can call its evenings, speak to its doubters and convert others. Without one, the faithful drift.
The role is given from the ideoligion's tab, and the council can name one when two could take it.
